question: Should OpenClaw runtime Docker/Podman containers expose the agent workspace at `/workspace`, or should `/workspace` remain sandbox-only?
rationale: Both choices are plausible, but the decision changes the container workspace contract across Docker, Podman, docs, and sandbox path semantics.

options.title: Implement a consistent runtime alias
options.body: Add a `/workspace` alias or bind contract across Dockerfile, Compose, setup helpers, Podman/Quadlet, docs, and smoke coverage so container users have one ergonomic path.

options.title: Document sandbox-only semantics
options.body: Keep runtime containers on `/home/node/.openclaw/workspace` and update docs/templates that imply `/workspace` is generally available.

options.title: Defer behind Docker sandbox path work
options.body: Resolve the adjacent Docker-outside-of-Docker sandbox path contract first, then apply one workspace path policy to runtime and sandbox containers.

recommendation.title: Implement a consistent runtime alias
recommendation.body: Add a `/workspace` alias or bind contract across Dockerfile, Compose, setup helpers, Podman/Quadlet, docs, and smoke coverage so container users have one ergonomic path.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current-source and recent Docker/sandbox history for the affected files and already supplied maintainer-side context for this issue.
